The '''Kuat Embassy''' was the official embassy of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. It was constructed mostly of expensive [[Marble/Legends|marble]] that [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]]&mdash;when he visited the embassy upon the invitation of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Haydnat Treen]]&mdash;estimated could buy him a new [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Backlash" />
